notes.title: September 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Yodhas![/h1]

The update you’ve all been waiting for is here: The Bazaar Update goes live, alongside other major quality of life changes, and a new bundle! We won’t keep you too long, as time can be so precious to us mere mortals.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_0d989a7a9a5b4e04bb5ebb890e85e8a2~mv2.png[/img]

[b]Notification System:[/b] New Bundles, Bazaar cards and Daily Free Bonus refresh will show a notification on the Store icon. We hope this helps you grab your rewards on refresh. 

[b]Daily Rewards:[/b] Players can now collect 15 Gold every 6 hours instead of 20 Gold every 24 hours. Additionally, players can now collect 10 Shards every 24 hours.

[b]Shards:[/b] New Shard amounts have been added at different denominations for purchase.

[b]Black Market Trader:[/b] [u]Now only offers unowned cards![/u] Legendary cards will refresh every 3 days instead of 7. Additionally, he will now accept coins as payment for Common and Rare cards.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_e93275f9c0ce41dd86f3f30f830b543f~mv2.png[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_cd542ba3f63947e394748d68a58973b3~mv2.png[/img]

New Bundles have been added to the store that offer a curated selection of three cards. These bundles aren’t just limited to units, spell bundles will also be available.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_d23748e33edb4cfda4e0dd95a2005c07~mv2.png[/img]

While we’re always looking for avenues to improve your gameplay experience, these improvements go live today:

[b]Move Queuing:[/b] multiple moves in game can now be made in a sequence. Most animations will no longer prevent the UI to be locked. No more waiting for animations to end before making a move.

[b]Campaign Dialogue Skips:[/b] A Skip button has been added during campaign dialogues which will appear on a few consecutive screen taps or clicks, allowing players to skip the entire dialog sequence.

[b]Opponent Disconnection Timer:[/b] A timer will now appear on an opponent's Hero frame when they disconnect. When it reaches 0, they will auto-resign. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_79a82f9064e949d6ba971d112c362ac5~mv2.png[/img]

[b]Inspire:[/b] The buff no longer activates on the unit casting Inspire. The buff will continue to work on other units you have deployed. 

[b]All Unit Cards that did 0 damage now have 1 damage:[/b]
[list]
[*] Herald
[*] Medic
[*] Kalia Lohar
[*] Forest Rakshasi
[*] Orangutan Vaanar
[*] War Chef
[/list]

[i]Note: 0 Damage cards are great at support but can be prime targets for Silence. We feel that it was important for them to retain some damage on the board even after being silenced. We will be closely monitoring these cards for future balance changes.[/i]


[b]Savitr:[/b] Armour reduced to 1 and Health reduced to 6 from 7 .
[b]Mantra of Fire:[/b] Cost reduced to 3 from 4.
[b]Spirit Apsara:[/b] Cost reduced to 1 from 2.
[b]Spirit Tiger:[/b] Damage increased from 1 to 2.
[b]Gorilla Vaanar:[/b] Cost reduced to 5 from 6.
[b]Maniman:[/b] Cost reduced to 5 from 7. Health reduced to 5 from 6.
[b]Dark Spirit Yaksha:[/b] No longer Ephemeral. Now has Necromancy and Mirage 
[b]Dushasana:[/b] stats are now 3/1/5 and costs 3 Soma.
[b]Bakasura:[/b] stats are now 4/0/6 and costs 4 Soma.

If you’d like to get involved with our community and look for early sneak peeks, here are our links: [url=https://www.studiosirah.com/discord]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/studiosirah/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@playkurukshetra]YouTube[/url].

See you on the battlefield!
[i]Studio Sirah[/i]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f5deb20e10fd4773ba391e2072142dbd~mv2.png[/img]

notes.title: March 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Yodhas![/h1]

This is a short update for March, as our Holi offer goes live with some visual overhauls, balance changes and bug fixes. We won’t keep you too long, as the summer sun grows warmer by the day!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_9305fec5e72249fc827cc6f32701b63d~mv2.png[/img]

The Festival Of Colour is upon us Yodhas, and with that comes our first-ever Holi Sale![b] For a limited time only, the realms of Paatal and Prithvi are discounted. [/b]So now is a great time to catch up, in preparation for Mount Meru!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_37325af34c7f4fcdb04f5fc8c05469d8~mv2.png[/img]

[b]New fonts[/b] have been added to the game for better visual clarity. [b]Match start VFX [/b]has been added, to improve animations for hero entry and card draws for better immersion into the vibrant world of Kurukshetra: Ascension, and [b]tutorial VFX[/b] to make it easier for new players to inspect cards and learn their properties.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f7a79c9500714c95a723839ebfea157c~mv2.png[/img]

We have been listening to feedback on the current meta, and have tweaked some cards to curb the current dominance of Chariots. [b]Disarm has also received significant changes.[/b]

- Gang Up: Changed to "All your Units regain their turn"
- Mahajan: Soma cost reduction of cards in hand is now 2 instead of 3
- Chariot Archer: Soma cost increased to 3 from 1 and damage reduced to 1 from 2
- Flame Sling: Soma cost has been increased to 3
- Balarama's Rage: Spell cards are now sent back to the opponent's deck instead of being permanently discarded
- Whiplash: Damage buff to Rakshasas is now reduced to 2 from 3
- Trickery: Surpanakha's Night Hero Power now sends back a random enemy card to their deck instead of permanently discarding them
- Disarm: The disarm property now returns the opponent's deployed weapon back to the deck instead of their hand
- Mayasura: Copied Unit no longer dies but is now Cursed. Cursed Units will transfer 1 attack from themselves to a random enemy 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_a8e31212c1f34ce88755f873af3a14fa~mv2.png[/img]

[b]Apart from bug fixes rolling out with this patch, we are actively hot-fixing bugs daily. If you do encounter any bugs please report them through the Studio Sirah Discord. [/b]

- Fixed a freeze related to Maniman
- Bheem's summon should no longer deploy Mareecha who will immediately die when summoned
- Fixed an intermittent issue that was causing game freeze due to temporary network disconnects
- Fixed an issue where Sanjana's heal was not removing burn and bleed
- Fixed a freeze related to Blitz
- Fixed a freeze related to Advanced Scout
- Fixed a visual bug with the Karma Pass VFX
- Fixed an issue where Bhishma was still attacking all enemies with Kaundinya even after being disarmed
- Fixed an issue which caused Duryodhana's Ethereal Army to grant Ephemeral permanently
- Fixed an issue with Rama's Shot inflicting incorrect damage 
- Fixed a bug where campaign store buffs were not getting applied.

If you’d like to get involved with our community and look for early updates, here are our links: [url=https://www.studiosirah.com/discord]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/kurukshetraascension/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@playkurukshetra]YouTube[/url].

See you on the battlefield!
[i]Studio Sirah[/i]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f5deb20e10fd4773ba391e2072142dbd~mv2.png[/img]

notes.title: The Apsara Court is our Biggest Update Yet!
notes.notes:
[i]Mesmerize the battlefield during the season of The Apsara Court! Let's dive into our biggest update yet![[/i]

[h1]Greetings Yodhas![/h1]

I hope that marching hasn’t tired you out Yodhas, as we have quite the journey before us! We visit The Apsara Court this season, to encounter a new faction of divine performers. Eleven new cards are entering the card pool, with two new properties. Realms have received some major reworks focusing on an elevated roguelike experience. New card frames, a new board, and an overhauled quest system are now live, so let’s just dive into this huge update.

[h2]New Karma Pass: The Apsara Court[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_d8110703d2bf40ec86babae9c990f7d6~mv2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Cards[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_98e07d119b004d909eecb8c3dfed48e5~mv2.jpg[/img]

Grab the all-new Karma Pass to instantly unlock THREE cards! Shakuntala, her lover Dushyanta, and their iconic Royal Ring. Scale up the track to unlock the distractingly beautiful Urvashi, who allows you to choose and draw legendary cards from your deck. Hit level 100 to unlock Ghritachi, to prevent your units from being charmed, while also being counter immune! New Apsara cards have also been added to the card pool, so good luck when you open your next card pack!

[h2]New Properties[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0c75f18107cc4578a7f3a45daec91207~mv2.jpg[/img]

Two new properties enter the game this season: Beloved, a tactician's dream, buffing other units' damage when your beloved unit takes damage. Distract, when timed well, makes your opponent's unit damage useless. 

[h2]Realm Rework[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0c3633b5c2f2494ba796bf9fb9d385ce~mv2.jpg[/img]

The next time you load into a realm, things are going to look a little different. New pathways and new challenges await you, with different opponents to choose from on these alternate paths. Replaying a realm has its own rewards too, with shortcuts opening up that allow players to skip certain opponents on their run. A few new mechanics have been added to the campaign such as Card Shuffle, The Forge, Mystery Nodes, and the Mini Store. 

Card Shuffle changes the way cards are added to your campaign deck. If at the end of the battle, a player isn’t satisfied with the cards offered to them, they can now reroll to get more options!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f172c913b8eb4ae99dbbed8873cebe2d~mv2.jpg[/img]

The Forge is where you personalize your starter deck. Defeating bosses will earn you forge points which allow you to edit one card in your starter deck per point. These changes are permanent through your future runs. Some forge points can also be present on the map so be on the lookout!

[img] https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0963762348544276867752dc32ff25b8~mv2.jpg[/img]

Players will now also encounter Mystery Nodes along the way. These unique nodes on the map are a small break from fighting and allow the player to gamble with their fate. The result can either buff or curse you. Are you willing to take a risk?

[img] https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_303fafdf513a41fb806f949ef5a24b6f~mv2.jpg[/img]

The Mini Store is where you can grab some power-ups Yodha! You’ll notice this cart carrying useful wares along your journey. And after hearing player feedback on permadeath, Amrith is being re-added to the game, to give you a second wind when you fall, along with other boosts and consumables. 

[h2]New Card Frames[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_25394471720e4ce1a70b960c4d5ffd0c~mv2.jpg[/img]

Card frames have received an upgrade! Our new stylized border draws inspiration from historical Indian art, while also clearly communicating card rarity. With gray being used for common cards, blue for rare cards, purple for epic cards, and ancient gold for legendary cards. 

[h2]New Board Design[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_268cc558358146768ee48ede6a763e15~mv2.jpg[/img]

Your hero now fights directly on the battlefield! Their hero powers have been moved to the left, along with new frames around the hero portrait. The board itself now feels more fluid based on the attack type of the heroes being played and will adapt based on melee or ranged heroes being played. Icons have been added to represent row types, with the range row now appearing slightly raised over the melee row. These changes now make your board truly feel like a battlefield! Icons and board UI have also been slightly refreshed.

[h2]Quest Rework[/h2]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1156887237447929937/1180752063311925342/image47.png?ex=657e900d&is=656c1b0d&hm=dfbe76baf260e85d1c51dd8c076e83a76bfcf789740604d27a382d6a39ebf15b&[/img]

Our quest system has been overhauled completely to reward daily playtime. Log in every day and grab yourself some easy Karma by completing daily tasks. These roll over to the next day once you have made some progress on them. You will now also receive one large quest that you can spend the week completing. This quest, however, does not roll over into the next week, so make sure you complete it for a large chunk of Karma!

[h2]Play Your Way[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_06dd70b7f19a42359de9a2aea8efb373~mv2.jpg[/img]

Player choice has been a high priority for us in this update, and we’re changing the way players can approach Kurukshetra: Ascension. On completing the tutorial the Ascension storyline and PvP queue unlock together. So, go ahead and play your way Yodhas!

[h2]New Animations[/h2]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_1d877f0035be4402af66daf9f1640f49~mv2.gif[/img]

We’re constantly working on improving the visual experience when playing Kurukshetra: Ascension. The forge is one example of the animations we’re overhauling, maps feel more alive, as nodes like the forge build onto the map.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f05705ef61594adfabdbde9209d14870~mv2.gif[/img]

Attack animations have all been updated, and attack properties such as Pierce and Smash are going to look and feel even better than before! Hop in-game to check out all of them.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[b]Neutral Cards:[/b]
- Jatayu: Soma cost increased to 6 from 4.
- Forest Giant: Damage reduced to 2 from 3.
- Battle Surgeon: Health reduced to 5 from 6.
- Naga Warrior: Health reduced to 4 from 5.
- River Giant: Health reduced to 5 from 6.
- Aruna: Soma cost reduced to 6 from 7.
- Tara: Soma cost reduced to 3 from 4.
- Takshaka: Health increased to 7 from 6.
- Jambavan: Damage increased to 4 from 3.
- Disarm Spell: Soma cost reduced to 3 from 5.
- Verumkai Assassin: Soma cost reduced to 6 from 7.
- Major Heal: Rarity is now Common.
- River Nagin: Health increased to 3 from 2.
- Mace Warrior: Rarity is now Common.
- Ice Giant: Rarity is now Common.
- Vaanar Archer: Health increased to 3 from 2.
- Royal Guard: Rarity is now Epic
- Swordsman: Soma cost reduced to 2 from 3. Health and Damage reduced to 2 from 3.
- Battle-Cry: Rarity is now Common

[b]Arjuna:[/b]
- Shock Archer: Health reduced to 2 from 3.
- Concentrate: Rarity is now Common.

[b]Sugriva:[/b]
- Hanuman's Aid: No longer provides healing, but now buffs the Health of all Units instead of only Vaanars.  Soma cost reduced to 2 from 4.
- Brotherhood: Brotherhood now buffs +1 dmg for all Units. Soma cost reduced to 3 from 4 and rarity is now Common.
- Renewal: Rarity is now Epic.

[b]Bhishma:[/b]
- Varunastra: Healing reduced to 3 from 4. Rarity is now Rare.
- Kaundinya: Soma cost increased to 7 from 6.
- River Channel: The description has been fixed to better indicate when the player will gain extra Soma
- Icy Breath: Rarity is now Rare.
- Blizzard: Now deals 1 damage to all enemies and Freezes them. Soma cost reduced to 2 from 4.

[b]Bheem:[/b]
- Tree Hurl: Rarity is now Epic.
- War Chef:  Now increases the Health of Units by +2 instead of +1

[b]Duryodhana:[/b]
- Kaurava Brother: Can now be added to the player's deck as a Unit.
- Trigarta: Can now be added to the player's deck as a Unit.
- Whirlwind: Rarity is now Epic.

[b]Surpanakha:[/b]
- Sniper Rakshasa: Rarity is now Rare.
- Minor Charm: Soma cost reduced to 2 from 3. Rarity is now Epic.
- Charm: Rarity is now Common.

Remember to check in over the next two months and complete your Daily and Weekly Quests to level up your Karma Pass. Other rewards include a ton of gold, shards, and even random cards! With our biggest update so far, we're looking forward to your valuable feedback.

If you’d like to get involved with our community and look for early updates, here are our links: [url=https://www.studiosirah.com/discord]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/studiosirah/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@playkurukshetra]YouTube[/url].


See you on the battlefield!
Studio Sirah

notes.title: Hotfix: 12th October
notes.notes:
[h3][u]Gameplay[/u][/h3]
- Properties will now be applied even if attacker damage is 0
- Defending target will now counterattack even if their damage is 0
- Defenders will not counterattack if the attacker has Charms, even if they cannot switch due to space constraints

[i][u]Dev Note:[/u] Until now, if the net damage inflicted by a Unit or Hero was 0, properties such as Stuns, Bleeds, etc. did not apply on the target. For e.g if a Shock Archer with 2 damage attacks a Unit with 2 Armour, the target Unit did not get stunned since it took 0 damage. We've decided to let the property apply even if the damage is 0 as it was causing some unforeseen edge cases which led to game desyncs and freezes. We understand that this might cause a slight shift in overall balance but there are more changes planned for future updates[/i] 

[h3][u]Hotfix[/u]
[/h3]
- Pradyota now correctly does not get Tapasya buff even after attacking
- Fixed an issue with Arjuna's divine double causing issues if the hand is full
- Fixed an issue with Alpha causing a freeze if the opponent health was higher than Bheem's
- Corrected some issues that could cause desync in Campaign battles
- Fixed an issue that was causing some units summoned through abilities of Vasuki, Bheem's summon power, Yuvraj, etc. to freeze the game
- Corrected an edge case with Sugriva's passive that was causing desyncs
- Fixed an issue that might cause players to desync in the tutorial
- Various other minor bugs and freezes

notes.title: Minor Hotfix
notes.notes:
Greetings Yoddhas!

A small update is out!

In this hotfix, we've focused primarily on addressing bugs and stability issues.

Here are the details:

Fixed an issue which prevented players from transitioning to Hell Hard mode
Fixed Night Cards for various Heroes which were causing desyncs
Added a new Underworld Board
Added a new Boon UI in the Story Campaign
Fixed an issue which prevented players from saving their decks with specific cards
Fixed an issue with Tiger Pup causing a freeze
Fixed various desyncs and freezes

Upcoming Balance Changes

We've been collecting feedback and data on Duels to get a view on the overall game balance. While we debated to push some minor balance changes in this build, we feel some larger fixes are required. 

Sugriva has been overperforming in the current meta and some nerfs for him are coming soon. We've been experimenting with tweaking his passive ability but we're not entirely happy with the results so far, hence the delay.

On the other hand, despite general buffs to defensive playstyles, we are still seeing that Bhishma is underperforming.

So, we are planning a larger balance update where we address all of these issues together. More on this soon!

That's all for now! See you in game!

notes.title: New Realm: Prithvi, Night Mode and UI changes!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Yodhas![/b]

Home is calling, the realm of man, vaanar and beast launches with this update, Prithvi! This update doesn’t just stop at a new realm but also brings a rework to our core card combat. We are redefining our meta and adding a unique mechanic carefully designed for Kurukshetra: Ascension. With player experience as our priority, the first rollout of our UI update and animation updates have also been implemented with this patch, along with some hero changes we hope to structure and balance the game with our new unique game mode in mind.

Let’s dive into it!

[h1]New Realm: Prithvi[/h1]

The realm of mortals brings with it three distinct kingdoms, each with their own trials, twists and challenges, we did not want to make this one easy! Journey first to the Khandava forest, under Lord Indra’s protection, where you’ll face off against the mythic beasts of the realm. The first boss you encounter will be a known face to those enjoying the Tribes of Kishkindha Karma Pass with the ferocity of Jambavan to contend with.

The next stop along your hero's journey would be Kishkindha, home of the mighty Vaanar Sena. Leap and climb your way through the treehouses and vines until you meet your final champion, but we have  added a twist to keep this bout interesting. 

Lastly, contend with the champions of Magadha, the great bastion of humanity, now in turmoil. Make your way to the Rajgriha and challenge the King, but we don’t want to spoil the rest. Enjoy the Prithvi Realm on our stunning new board, and we can’t wait for you to play it.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_662b4ff00e6f48ffad2ccec7214e10d9~mv2.png[/img]

[h1]Night Mode:[/h1]

We’re in the Endgame now. We are redefining the way players approach combat with an overhaul to our core gameplay. Available to a Hero that has reached level 20, Night Mode. Inspired by our namesake, the great Kurukshetra war and battles of old, players are given time to strategize upon nightfall. 

After playing 4 turns each, day turns to night on the battlefield. Turn five will be played by both players at the same time. This means you and your opponent will be playing actively not just to counter each other, but to make moves with the new cards being added that can be played on “night” turns. During this time both players make card and buff choices to strengthen their strategy.

This addition to card based combat is our approach to adding a mechanic unique to Kurukshetra: Ascension. Meta breaking and rebuilding is our goal and your feedback during this shakeup is going to shape the future of Kurukshetra: Ascension!

Stay tuned for more announcements about this game mode and check out the new card design coming with it! 

[i][u]Note: There is a known bug where in your very first night battle there is a small chance that your choice will get skipped. This will occur only on your first battle.[/u][/i]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_ae482503b5bf483c98abb56f0b9ec42f~mv2.png[/img]

[h1]
New UI and Animations:[/h1]

We take player experience very seriously with every feature in the game, be it old or new. Our new UI aims to do much more than functionality - We have also crafted a new visual language inspired by thousands of years of Indian design.

We start this with a lobby refresh, where you can see new buttons and a visual aesthetic that fits with the core identity of Kurukshetra: Ascension. Check out the new buttons, hero portraits and more.

Card pack reveals needed to capture the epicness of earning that sweet sweet reward at the end of it. So, we’re rolling out a new graphic, animation and an announcer for extra pizazz. Now it feels oh-so much more satisfying when you find that legendary you’ve been chasing.

These are just a part of our UI updates with more to roll out over the course of future patches.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_dcd209b4abdd4c15805be25135dbf67d~mv2.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]

We've been noticing aggressive playstyles performing relatively better than others and certain neutral cards being widely used by all Heroes.

While this is not necessarily a bad thing, we feel it limits the uniqueness of the gameplay that each Hero has to offer, especially if these cards comprise a large portion of their decks.

So, we've decided to make some minor changes to the following cards...

[b]Arjuna[/b]

Discharge cost reduced from 3 to 2 Soma.
Manavastra now pierces as well.
Execute cost reduced from 5 to 3 Soma.
Gandiva now does not pierce.

[b]Duryodhana[/b]

Gandhari’s Blessing cost increased from 2 to 3.
Scavenger cost reduced to 3.
Envy cost reduced from 2 to 1 Soma.
Revenge now deals 5 damage to an enemy that attacked you last turn.

[b]Bheem[/b]

Spotter is now a 0-0-4 ranged unit.
Sutasoma damage reduced from 5 to 4.
Flex now affects Heroes.
Tree Hurl smashes 1 instead of 2.
[b]
Bhishma[/b]

Freezing Arrow can now target heroes.
Barrage can now Pierce.
Divine light cost decreased from 3 to 2 Soma.
Daze now costs 3 soma

[b]Surpanakha[/b]

Charm now lasts until the end of your next turn.
Convert cost decreased from 10 to 9 Soma.
Betrayal cost reduced to 0 Soma

[b]Neutral[/b]
Blood Bag (Buff reduced from 3 to 2 Health)
Knife Throw (Damage reduced from 3 to 2)
Noose of Pain (Cost increased from 4 to 6) 


All that being said? We haven’t been able to cover everything here and hope to see you discover the rest when playing the campaign! We hope you enjoy the new realm update and look forward to suggestions and feedback. If you’d like to get involved with our community and look for early updates, here are our links:  [url=https://discord.com/invite/XhyrvUe2vW]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/studiosirah/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@playkurukshetra/]YouTube[/url].


See you on the battlefield!
[i]Studio Sirah[/i]

notes.title: Game Optimization and Balance Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Everyone!

While we are aware that everyone is anxious to see the new Hero Sugriva in action, we've had to take a detour in development which we feel was critical in the long run of the game.

This detour we took was for Game Optimization and Balance Changes.

[h2]Game Optimization[/h2]

Game Optimization means that we went deep into our game files and cleaned them up thoroughly. Think of it as a yearly deep clean of your home after which everything feels fresh and new.

We identified a few bottlenecks that were impacting game execution the most and restructured them.
The result should be a much better game performance especially on relatively lower end devices.

So, you can expect to see a much smoother gameplay! 

[h2]Major Balance Changes[/h2]

We have been closely monitoring the Hero Weapon meta that has developed in PvP.

While we intended weapons to be powerful, the ramp up to high amounts of weapon damage was easily achieved without any consequence and in most cases resulted in limiting the number of viable options for both players.

One of the biggest issues that came to light was that deploying most units generally became disadvantageous. 

So, to address this core problem we've introduced a new Card Property: Disarm

[u][h3]New Property and Game Mechanics[/h3][/u]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_c1a6236d188a45f094dc87573ecb7193~mv2.png[/img]

Disarm: Returns enemy weapon to their hand. Removes all Weapon buffs.

Units with Disarm when deployed cause the enemy Hero's weapon to return to their hand.

Additionally, we have divided the Hero Damage modifiers in two parts:
1. Hero Buff
2. Weapon Buff

Spells and Powers which increase damage through Weapon Buff will be removed if disarmed.

For example, Weapon Enhancement (Vriddhi) is now a Weapon Buff. This means if a Hero used Weapon Enhancement but later gets disarmed, the +2 damage from it will be lost.

But Duryodhana's Spell Balarama's Blessing which gives +1 damage is now a Hero Buff and will not be affected by disarm.

All damage can still be reduced through poison.


[h2]Quests[/h2]

While with these changes we hope to bring long term benefits to the game, due to this detour we have unfortunately not been able to revamp the new quest system. 

Since the new quest system was designed to completely overhaul the existing one, we are at a stage where we cannot implement the old quest system.

This means that [h3][u][b]No quests will be working till we release the next update[/b][/u][/h3]

While we know this is not the best experience, we hope that everyone can be patient a little longer for the next update to bring in the new quest system.


[u][h3]Detailed List of Balance Changes[/h3][/u]

[b][u]Card Properties[/u][/b]

All status effects like Freeze, Bleed, Burn, Stun, etc. now apply on Heroes, but no longer stacks in intensity.

notes.title: Major Patch - Mar 18
notes.notes:
Hi folks! Thanks to a bunch of feedback from the community, we have made many improvements to the gameplay and UI, as well as fixed several bugs.

- Balancing change: Arjuna counter-damage increased
- New VFX for stun, silence and several hero spells
- UI improvements: login panel, challenge notification, in-game draw button, deck selection in deckbuilder, friends and leaderboard lists
- Panel sizes have been better adjusted for various screens
- Fixed bug where withdrawing units (e.g. roar, fear) could be re-deployed for free
- Fixed bug where tutorial checkpoints were occasionally getting restored incorrectly
- Fixed bug with envy causing error when hand was full
- Fixed bug where the buffs that a unit provided would get restored on stun end even if the unit was silenced
- Fixed freeze on timed end turn from server
- Fixed bug where miraging units were increasing in cost instead of decreasing
- Fixed bug where bots had more than maximum copies of a card in their deck
